releases.notes:
## What's new

- Checks once per Minecraft launch for a newer stable GitHub release after the first world or server join.
- Shows one clickable local chat notice when an update is available.
- Runs asynchronously, keeps failures out of chat, and never downloads or installs updates automatically.
- Validates stable versions and release links before notifying.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer compatible release
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11 or newer compatible release
- Java 21

## Installation

Download `fishon-standing-camera-1.1.0.jar`, place it in the client instance's `mods` folder, remove older copies, and restart Minecraft. Do not install the `-sources.jar` as the playable mod.

## Verification and safety

All 20 automated tests pass. SHA-256 checksums are attached. Camera behavior remains client-only: real Sneak state, movement, pose, collision, ledge protection, and networking are unchanged. The update check is an unauthenticated GitHub request and sends no Minecraft identity, server, world, gameplay, machine identifier, or telemetry data.

releases.notes:
Client-only Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that keeps the first-person camera at standing eye height while FishOnMC uses Sneak for fishing tension.

The real Sneak action remains active: FishOn tension control, crouched movement, collision, ledge protection, player pose, and client-to-server packets are unchanged. Version 1.0.1 applies the camera correction every rendered frame and removes the initial one-frame camera dip.

Install: place fishon-standing-camera-1.0.1.jar in the client mods folder and restart Minecraft. Keep only one version installed.

FishOn visual suite:
- Rustic Fantasy 128 fish-only textures: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishonmc-rustic-fantasy-128
- FishOn Fish Scale: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishon-fish-scale
- FishOn Standing Camera: https://github.com/finalpantasy/fishon-standing-camera

Unofficial fan project; not affiliated with or endorsed by FishOnMC, Mojang, or Microsoft. OpenAI coding tools assisted with implementation, debugging, documentation, and validation.
